title: Chapter 668
text:
The effects of the five abilities were not bad, and they all had their own strengths.

[Cell Resonance] could instantly recover energy and clear a debuff at the same time. It could be used by any class, and it was a powerful support ability.

[Electromagnetic Resonance] was also a good support ability that could reduce the strength of the target. When facing opponents of the same level, it could quickly gain an advantage. [Stress Critical Hit] was an explosive damage skill. Although it had only one use, it was still passable.

[Will to Fight to the Death] was a tank type talent. The + 180 bonus to END was not low, but it had a negative effect. Han Xiao felt that he was enough as a tank and was not interested in this talent at all.

Luckily, the lowest attribute is 0. Otherwise, with my single-digit Luck, it would be a double-digit Luck … Han Xiao complained.

What surprised him was the fifth option, [Legendary Battle Technique].

This was a proper Molding Talent!

Furthermore, it was one of the top 'Battle Technique' talents!

For every three attacks, the third attack would deal 35% True Damage. This talent was a passive ability and did not consume any energy. It was equivalent to his attack power increasing by a large margin.

With the attack speed of a Calamity Grade Super, how many times could a Calamity Grade Super attack be triggered in a single second?

This was really awesome!

You have received [Legendary Battle Technique]!

I'm rich, I'm rich! I've earned big this time!

Han Xiao's chest trembled in excitement. He hurried to the combat training room to test his new talent.

The floor cracked open, and the alloy wall to test the damage rose. Han Xiao hammered the wall.

True Damage ignored Defense. For example, if an attack with a theoretical damage of 10,000 was reduced by 50% by the target's Defense, it could deal 5,000 damage with 35% True Damage. That was equivalent to 5,000 + 3,500 damage, almost double the damage!

If the attack was completely blocked by a shield, magic shield, or mechanical heavy armor, the effect of True Damage would be applied to the shield value and armor value. Only when the enemy actually took the attack would it deal True Damage to the enemy.

Therefore, Magic Tanks and Mechanical Tanks were slightly better off, but tank types would be completely countered by this move!

"That was close. If it wasn't for the leader's ability, I'm afraid I would have suffered a lot from her beating." Han Xiao jiggled his chest muscles and secretly rejoiced.

No wonder Stephanie was a boss-type character. This ability was insane.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed with excitement. His ability as a tank was already extremely strong. In comparison, although the attack power of his Army Style was not weak, it was not as important as his ability as a tank because he often fought against opponents of a higher level or was surrounded. Most of the time, he relied on his ability as a tank to wear down his opponents.

In truth, if they only used the orthodox Army Style, if they fought against Han Xiao in a one on one battle, they would only end up being crushed by him. This was especially true after Han Xiao had mastered psionic energy. He did not need to rely on his tank ability to fight against many enemies, and he was extremely powerful.

However, the HP/MP conversion was simply too eye-catching, and it was a BOSS-level ability. This caused the Army Style to lose a lot of its luster. His' Indestructible Body 'nickname had suppressed his existence as a Mechanic for far too long.

However, it was different now!

[Legendary Combat Technique] was already powerful enough in the hands of others, but in the hands of an Army Style Mechanic, the effect was insane!

In his previous life, there was a similar NPC as an example. Han Technician knew that this talent could be used on summoned creatures and the Mech Legion. The summoned creatures would enjoy the bonus of the Mage's talent through the Mana Connection, and the Mech Legion would share the effect of this talent through the Mechanical Force enhancement. After all, the Mech Legion was also considered as a type of 'mechanical equipment' and would receive the same bonuses as the weapons in their hands.

Han Xiao opened up a few elite mechanical soldiers that he carried around with him to test and figure out the mechanism of this talent.

Machines that received the bonus of Mechanical Force would have the effect of [Legendary Combat Technique] by default. This meant that the same machine would be able to trigger one True Damage every time it attacked three times instead of counting the total number of attacks.

To put it simply, an Oathkeeper would have to attack three times to trigger the talent. If it was the Psionic Sky Cannon, it would also have to attack three times to trigger the talent. However, the Oathkeeper would only attack twice, and the third attack would be fired by the Sky Cannon, which would not trigger the talent. This meant that the number of attacks of each machine would be counted separately and would not stack.

Han Xiao could not help but fantasize. If the total number of attacks was calculated … it would be equivalent to a hundred machines firing once, and thirty-three out of a hundred attacks would be True Damage. It would really be like sweeping through the world. Why would he still need a bicycle?

After giving himself a gentle slap, Han Xiao reluctantly put away his fantasy.

"Phew, although the number of attacks can't be counted separately, it's still insane enough."

Han Xiao was already very satisfied. The calculation mechanism was that a hundred machines would fire three times in a row, a total of three hundred attacks, and the last hundred would all be True Damage. The ratio of True Damage was the same as the total number of attacks, but the difference was that the frequency of attacks would be reduced.

However, this talent did not need to hit the enemy to take effect. Three slashes in the air could still trigger it!

This meant that the timing of the talent's activation could be controlled. If used well, it could even cause every machine that hit the enemy to deal True Damage.

Han Xiao immediately thought of all sorts of ways to operate it, and he became excited.

A powerful talent could cause a person's combat strength to undergo an earth-shattering change.

In Han Technician's eyes, [Legendary Battle Technique] was on the same level as the ability to convert health to energy. It would once again increase the damage of the Mech Legion!

"If I can realize this idea, my actual combat strength will probably increase by several times! I might really be able to sweep through anyone below Beyond Grade A! "

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and the excitement in his heart almost burst out.

The effect of this wave of looting was simply fantastical!

[Prey] was indeed a hidden mission. The mission description of 'using battle to support battle' was not just for show. Although he had been targeted by Thousand Shadows, to be able to obtain this talent, Han Xiao felt that it was worth it.

Not only was it worth it, but it was even worth it!

Han Xiao opened his interface and browsed through it. He was so strong that even he was afraid of it.

He was worried that after returning to the main battlefield, the enemy would only send a few people to stall him and reduce his threat level.

But now, if there were fewer people, he could go on a killing spree!

Han Xiao locked himself in the machinery modification room. Making use of the last ten days, he planned to adjust Philip's battle control mode so that the mechanical army could display the power of the (Legendary Grade Battle Technique). For example, he could specifically leave a cannon unit for the third attack on standby and use the other units of the army to distract the enemy and create an opportunity to focus fire, ensuring that the enemy would receive tons of damage. However, this required a large number of calculation modules for the army to work together.

The matters of the Black Star Corps would be handled by Herlous and the others, so he did not need to worry. Increasing his strength as the leader was the main way to increase the status of the Black Star Corps.

The secret war in the Colton Star Cluster was in full swing. The flames of war were everywhere in the West Wind, Chaida, and Kaya Star Systems.

The two sides had different thoughts. Ralph was prepared to remind Black Star to return to the battlefield. He needed him to stabilize the situation of the high-level combatants. Jorde, who was in the Bloodshed Land's command center, was also wary of Black Star, who had disappeared for two months.

…

At the same time, in the palace of the Hidden Red Robe Abbey.

In the center of the palace, Austin was floating about four meters above the ground. His loose robe that did not fit him dragged all the way to the ground. Desoro and the other Forbidden Sorcerers were beside him.

"I didn't expect … that he would change so much."

Austin slowly opened his eyes and sighed.

The surrounding Forbidden Sorcerers all had strange expressions on their faces. Some time ago, Austin had summoned Lagi, and everyone had watched the entire conversation.

Lagi was Austin's fourth disciple. All the Mages present had followed Austin for a long time, and everyone knew Lagi. However, when they met again after such a long time, the former Forbidden Sorcerer commander who used to be swift and decisive was like a completely different person …

Everyone could not imagine what Lagi had gone through in the past few years.

"However …" Austin shook his head. "Although his personality has changed, his heart is still as determined as before. He actually rejected me so straightforwardly."

After banishing Lagi for so many years, Austin had already forgiven him for his past mistakes. Thus, he asked Lagi if he was willing to return to his side. To his surprise, Lagi did not hesitate at all and was determined to return to Black Star's side.

Although Lagi acted casually, Austin could tell that Lagi was actually very grateful to Black Star for saving him and no longer had any attachment to the Hidden Red Robe Abbey. Black Star had replaced his position and obtained Lagi's initial loyalty. Lagi was not only doing this out of gratitude but also because he was optimistic about Black Star's future.

When he saw the Observer's Mark on Lagi's head, he also understood what Han Xiao meant. He wanted to use the Observer's Mark even though he knew that it would be discovered. This was to show that he valued Lagi.

Seeing this, Austin did not force it and was willing to fulfill his wish.

"Following a Beyond Grade A seed is destined to be filled with danger. Don't die …" Austin sighed.

At the dock outside the palace, Lagi was walking toward the spaceship. When he arrived, many Forbidden Sorcerers came out to welcome him. When he left, he was alone, and no one sent him off.

Turning around, he took one last look at this Mage Palace that he was once extremely familiar with. A hint of nostalgia appeared in his eyes. He shook his head and strode onto the spaceship.

Chi!

The cabin door closed, covering his lonely yet straight back.

The spaceship slowly rose into the air, turned into a stream of light, and disappeared without a trace.

…
